en.title: Marvel Rivals Modder Transforms Psylocke into Resident Evil's Ada Wong
en.summary: A talented fan has reimagined Psylocke's sleek Business Elite skin in Marvel Rivals, giving it the iconic look of Resident Evil's mysterious operative, Ada Wong. This creative mod offers a glimpse into potential cross-franchise aesthetics that players are eager to see.
en.body:
While **Marvel Rivals** offers a robust selection of cosmetic options for its diverse roster of heroes, the game currently lacks official crossover skins from other major franchises. However, the passionate modding community is already bridging this gap. A recent creation by user **miucels** on X (formerly Twitter) has transformed **Psylocke**'s sophisticated Business Elite skin, originally from the Godbomb battle pass, into the unmistakable likeness of **Ada Wong** from the **Resident Evil** series.

This impressive fan-made mod allows players to inject a bit of survival horror flair into their **Marvel Rivals** matches. While the mod primarily affects the visual appearance, it's noted that the **Ada Wong** skin will predominantly be visible during intro sequences and MVP screens, provided the player has the original Business Elite variant equipped. Nevertheless, it serves as a compelling demonstration of how players are creatively engaging with the game's aesthetics and expressing their love for multiple beloved franchises.

## A Crossover Dream

The emergence of this mod has been met with considerable enthusiasm within the gaming community, quickly gaining attention from outlets like TheGamer and showcasing on YouTube channels such as ZGS and No More Lines. It taps into a widespread desire among fans for more ambitious crossover content in hero-based games. The **Resident Evil** franchise, with its iconic characters and distinct visual style, presents a compelling contrast and complement to the vibrant Marvel universe, sparking conversations about what other dream collaborations might be possible.

This kind of community-driven creativity not only enhances the player experience but also serves as valuable feedback for developers. It underscores the demand for unique skins and the potential appeal of blending different gaming worlds. For players who are fans of both **Marvel Rivals** and **Resident Evil**, seeing **Ada Wong** inhabit the world of **Marvel Rivals**, even through a mod, is a thrilling prospect that fuels speculation about future official content.

## Community Creation and Visibility

The mod's creator, **miucels**, has shared their work, and it has been amplified by others keen to showcase this fusion of universes. Videos demonstrating the mod in action often highlight the visual fidelity achieved, transforming **Psylocke**'s model into **Ada Wong** with remarkable accuracy. While the current implementation has some limitations regarding in-game visibility, the core achievement is the successful visual transplant, which resonates deeply with fans who appreciate such intricate work.

The buzz around this mod suggests a strong appetite for more imaginative cosmetic designs. It’s a testament to the power of fan dedication and a reminder that the most exciting innovations can often come from the community itself, pushing the boundaries of what players expect from their favorite games.

## What's Next

As **Marvel Rivals** continues its development and prepares for its official launch, the developers will undoubtedly be observing community reactions and trends. While official cross-franchise collaborations remain speculative, the success of mods like the **Ada Wong** skin for **Psylocke** clearly indicates a receptive audience for bold and unexpected cosmetic themes. Players will be watching closely to see if any official developments echo these fan-driven desires.

content_raw: Marvel Rivals has no shortage of cosmetics to satisfy whatever preferences you have, but one thing that the Overwatch competitor severely lacks is crossover skins. While this isn't as much of a problem considering the Marvel universe has practically unlimited character variants and cosmetic themes to borrow, there is still plenty of demand for cross-franchise collaborations.
